simple.summary: גָּשַׁם (gâsham) means to shower violently First listed occurrence: Jer 14 22.

definitions.full: H1652. gasham [ גשׁם ] verb denominative (compare Late Hebrew Qal Passive participle & Hoph`al) — Pu`al Perfect 3feminine singular גֻּשְׁמָ֯ה Ezek 22:24 be rained upon ( גֻּשְׁמָהּ Baer, but see Ke Sm). Hiph`il cause or send rain , Participle מַגְשִׁמִים Jer 14:22 .
